name: Chao Ling-chih
bio: Chao Ling-chih (趙令畤; Zhao Lingzhi; 1061–1134) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 蝶恋花 (Die lian hua)
poems.author: Chao Ling-chih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
欲减罗衣寒未去。
不卷珠帘，人在深深处。
红杏枝头花几许。
啼痕止恨清明雨。
尽日沈烟香一缕。
宿酒醒迟，恼破春情绪。
飞燕又将归信误。
小屏风上西江路。
